verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the sensor PCB as a connector hub for sensor modules, defining its hardware role and scope.
The freelancer explicitly identifies unresolved connector requirements for the sensor PCB, materially blocking connector-matrix implementation.
The client specifies the sensor board's input and module-facing connector types, pin assignments, cable compatibility, and total connector count.
The client's detailed connector matrix resolves the implementation-blocking uncertainty and returns the requirement to active work.
The client establishes the schematic reference names for the two main-board input connectors, affecting the connector interface definition.
